title: Neural Graph Simulator for Complex Systems
abstract: arXiv:2411.09120v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Simulating complex systems governed by coupled ordinary differential equations (ODEs) typically requires explicit governing equations and incurs high computational cost from iterative numerical solvers. We propose the Neural Graph Simulator (NGS), a general-purpose data-driven framework that learns multivariate continuous-time dynamics directly from noisy and incomplete observations, without prior knowledge of the equations. Unlike neural ODE-based approaches that depend on repeated solver evaluations, NGS approximates the state transition integral using elapsed time intervals as direct inputs. This eliminates numerical integration while naturally supporting irregular sampling and heterogeneous time scales. Through its graph network architecture, NGS generalizes to unseen graph structures and larger system sizes, as demonstrated on independently sampled Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi graphs. translated_title: 面向复杂系统的神经图模拟器
translated_abstract: 模拟由耦合常微分方程（ODE）支配的复杂系统通常需要明确的控制方程，并且迭代数值求解器会带来高昂的计算成本。我们提出了神经图模拟器，这是一个通用的数据驱动框架，可以直接从含噪且不完整的观测数据中学习多元连续时间动力学，而无需对方程的先验知识。与依赖重复求解器求解的基于神经常微分方程的方法不同，NGS 将流逝的时间间隔作为直接输入来近似状态转移积分，从而避免了数值积分，同时天然支持不规则采样和异构时间尺度。凭借其图网络架构，NGS 能够泛化到未见过的图结构和更大的系统规模，这一点在独立采样的 Erdős–Rényi 图上得到了验证。我们在涵盖多种动力学系统的综合基准上对 NGS 进行了评估。
tldr: 提出神经图模拟器（NGS），一个无需控制方程先验知识、直接从含噪不完整观测中学习多元连续时间动力学的通用数据驱动框架，其以时间间隔为输入避免数值积分，并可泛化至未见过的图结构和更大规模的系统。
en_tdlr: NGS is a general-purpose data-driven framework that learns multivariate continuous-time dynamics from noisy, incomplete observations without governing equations, eliminating numerical integration by using elapsed time intervals as direct inputs while generalizing to unseen graph structures and larger system sizes.
